definition.description: The absolute number of lymphocytes per microliter of blood.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the absolute lymphocyte count (ALC) from the pretreatment complete blood count (CBC) or laboratory report.
definition.missing_value_rule: If the absolute lymphocyte count is not provided, represent as null.
definition.name: absolute_lymphocyte_count

definition.description: The absolute number of neutrophils per microliter of blood.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the absolute neutrophil count (ANC) from the complete blood count (CBC) or laboratory results in the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the ANC is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: absolute_neutrophil_count

definition.description: Whether acetaminophen was administered to the patient during the pretreatment period.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if acetaminophen was administered by reviewing the medication administration record (MAR), medication orders, or clinical notes documenting the administration of the drug.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if documentation is absent or ambiguous regarding whether the medication was actually administered.
definition.name: acetaminophen_administered

definition.description: Presence of molecular alterations in a patient that are actionable for targeted therapy.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient's molecular or genetic testing results indicate the presence of any alterations classified as clinically actionable.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no molecular testing results are documented or if the actionability of identified mutations is not specified.
definition.name: actionable_molecular_alterations

definition.description: Whether the patient has a documented history of acute kidney injury (AKI).
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the presence or absence of a diagnosis of acute kidney injury (AKI) from the patient's medical history, problem list, or review of systems.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the record neither confirms nor denies a history of AKI.
definition.name: acute_kidney_injury_history

definition.description: Whether the patient received adjuvant chemotherapy following primary treatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if adjuvant chemotherapy was administered by searching for explicit mentions of 'adjuvant chemotherapy' or specific chemotherapy regimens (e.g., 'pemetrexed 4 cycles') documented as being given in the adjuvant setting.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the patient record contains no information regarding the administration of adjuvant chemotherapy.
definition.name: adjuvant_chemotherapy_administered

definition.description: The presence of metastatic disease in the adrenal glands.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if the pretreatment clinical record (specifically radiology reports such as CT or PET/CT, or oncology progress notes) indicates the presence of metastatic lesions in the adrenal glands. This includes explicit mentions of 'adrenal metastasis', 'metastatic involvement' of the adrenal glands, or radiographic findings described as 'consistent with' or 'suspicious for' metastasis in the adrenal glands.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the adrenal glands are not mentioned or if the documentation is too ambiguous to determine presence or absence.
definition.name: adrenal_metastasis_presence

definition.description: The maximum diameter of an adrenal nodule.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the largest adrenal nodule size reported in imaging (e.g., CT), typically measured in centimeters.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if no adrenal nodule is documented or if the size is not specified.
definition.name: adrenal_nodule_size

definition.description: The age of the patient at the time of the clinical encounter or index date.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's age in years from the demographic section, pathology reports, or clinical narratives (e.g., '86-year-old', 'age 45').
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if age is not documented or is ambiguous.
definition.name: age

definition.description: Presence of pathological involvement of the airway.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether the patient record or imaging reports indicate that the airway (specifically the central airway) is involved by a disease process.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the record does not mention airway involvement or is ambiguous.
definition.name: airway_involvement

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
